papers.title_en: Opinion Leader Dynamics: How Sparse Attention Shapes Token Clustering
papers.evidence: 稀疏注意力如何塑造词元表示演化的理论分析
papers.tldr: 稀疏注意力虽能降低全局自注意力二次开销，但其受限交互如何塑造 token 表示演化仍缺乏理论解释。作者将 token 视为单位球上的粒子，提出“意见领袖动力学”，用显式固定代表与隐式断连交互群两种机制刻画组内收敛与组间分离，并写成反向 Wasserstein 梯度流，证明适当条件下指数收敛。在四个基准上，Kimi-K3、MiniMax-M3、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的投影 token 表示比稠密模型 GLM-4.7-Flash 呈现更清晰聚类分离和更高聚类分数，有限粒子模拟验证理论收敛，表明稀疏注意力可形成多组吸引子并兼顾组内对齐与组间区分。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention reduces the quadratic cost of global self-attention while retaining strong empirical performance, but how its restricted interactions shape the evolution of token representations remains theoretically underexplored. Modeling tokens as particles on the unit sphere, we introduce opinion leader dynamics, a framework that identifies two mechanisms through which token groups converge internally while maintaining distinct limiting directions. In the explicit model, fixed representatives induce a potential that attracts tokens toward distinct local maxima. In the implicit model, disconnected interaction groups evolve toward separate consensus directions. We formulate both models as reverse Wasserstein gradient flows and establish exponential convergence under suitable conditions. We further connect these theoretical predictions to token evolution in frontier sparse-attention LLMs that motivate our framework. Across four benchmarks, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash consistently exhibit clearer cluster separation and higher clustering scores than the dense-attention model GLM-4.7-Flash in projected token representations. These observations support the relevance of the predicted multiple-group structure to trained frontier LLMs, while finite-particle simulations illustrate the theoretical convergence behavior. Together, our results connect restricted token interactions to distinct group-level attractors, providing a dynamical account of how sparse attention can support alignment within groups while preserving separation between them.

papers.title_en: Attention Routing Stabilizes Early: Working-Set Inference for Recurrent Language Models
papers.evidence: 免训练复用稀疏工作集注意力以降低循环推理开销
papers.tldr: 循环语言模型在推理时每步都重算全局注意力，计算昂贵。作者发现注意力路由远早于隐状态稳定，据此提出免训练WISE：早期用全局注意力发现稀疏工作集，后期复用块状支持并保持动态计算。多跳问答上基本保持全注意力性能，2K上下文无损、4K略有损失；优化实现4K注意力最高1.76倍加速，完整32步轨迹1.36倍。该工作揭示注意力路由早期稳定，为循环模型提供高效推理路径。
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent language models repeatedly apply shared network blocks to refine latent representations, but standard inference recomputes global attention at every recurrent step. We study attention dynamics across recurrent depth and find that attention support and distributions stabilize substantially earlier than hidden states and attention outputs. This suggests a two-stage structure: early steps discover a sparse working set of relevant context, while later steps refine representations over largely the same routing support. Motivated by this structure, we introduce WISE (Working-set Inference with Support Exploitation), a training-free method that uses unrestricted global attention during early recurrence and later reuses directly discovered block-structured support while keeping recurrent depth and within-support attention computation dynamic. Controlled interventions show that recurrent discovery is important and that support-only reuse better preserves model behavior than more restrictive attention-reuse alternatives. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, WISE largely preserves full-attention performance, while context scaling reveals increasingly sparse working sets and greater efficiency gains. Quality is largely preserved through 2K context, with a measurable loss at 4K. An optimized sparse-attention implementation achieves up to a 1.76x attention speedup over native FlashAttention at 4K and a 1.36x speedup for the full 32-step attention trajectory. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbn5pj/WISE_code.
